architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: script/spike/stripe-seat-sync-probe.ts and its helper modules under script/spike/stripe-seat-sync-probe/ probe, in Stripe test mode and the WorkOS Staging environment, the WorkOS Stripe Seat Sync meter (one membership, a second, one removed), a Checkout Session in subscription mode with required terms acceptance and Stripe Tax for the metered price, a local webhook listener that the Stripe CLI forwards to, with the SDK signature check, and a test clock that bills three reported seats and cancels the subscription after its failed payment retries; with a dry-run mode, a reads-only preflight, guards that stop a live Stripe key, a WorkOS production key, and the production client before any call, a --workos-only mode, and a cleanup that deletes every object of the run by its run token, also after a failure or the first stop signal. It reuses the step runner and the polls of the SO-01c probe. The new dev dependency stripe, pinned to 23.0.1 in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, is used only by this probe; no file under src/ imports it, and it runs in no build, image, or production path. knip lists the script as an entry point. The Slice 1 evidence record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s1.md gains the section SO-01f: Stripe Checkout, webhooks, test clocks, and WorkOS seat sync, and the SO-01f ticket of docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md names it. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
